# DNS Made Easy
> Managed DNS business services and solutions provider offering authoritative DNS, failover, traffic management, analytics, and integrations.

DNS Made Easy provides enterprise DNS infrastructure and related traffic control features for uptime, performance, and operational visibility. Its main site covers product capabilities, pricing, FAQs, and blog content, while the support site hosts tutorials and knowledge base documentation.

## Core Product Pages
- [Managed DNS](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/): Overview of the company’s managed DNS platform and business DNS services.
- [DNS Failover](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/dns-failover): Automatic DNS-based failover for improved availability during endpoint or infrastructure outages.
- [ANAME Records](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/aname-records): Apex-compatible record type for pointing root domains to dynamic hostnames.
- [Global Traffic Director](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/global-traffic-director): Traffic steering and load distribution across multiple endpoints and geographic regions.
- [Secondary DNS](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/secondary-dns): Secondary authoritative DNS service for redundancy and resilience alongside primary providers.
- [DNS Analytics](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/dns-analytics): DNS query analytics and reporting for traffic visibility and operational insight.
- [Real-Time Traffic Anomaly Detection](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/real-time-traffic-anomaly-detection): Detection of unusual DNS traffic patterns to support rapid incident response.
- [Integrations](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/integrations): Supported integrations and ecosystem connections for automation and monitoring workflows.

## Product Features and Traffic Management
- [DNS Failover](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/dns-failover): Monitors services and reroutes DNS responses when failures are detected.
- [Global Traffic Director](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/global-traffic-director): Directs users to optimal resources based on policy and availability.
- [Secondary DNS](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/secondary-dns): Adds authoritative DNS redundancy to reduce single-provider risk.
- [ANAME Records](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/aname-records): Simplifies root-domain aliasing without requiring CNAME records at the zone apex.
- [DNS Analytics](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/dns-analytics): Helps teams understand DNS usage trends and query distribution.
- [Real-Time Traffic Anomaly Detection](https://dnsmadeeasy.com/real-time-traffic-anomaly-detection): Surfaces suspicious or abnormal traffic behavior in near real time.
